statement: With re-attach off and both register shims on, Dolphin does not re-send 0x12 after mode 05, never reads F6, and receives zero post-map MP or child frames over 180 seconds, reproducing W9f. Native post-map A400F0=55 count is zero. Scope is virtual Original with hid-wiimote not bound, test/dev under #258; not game, radio, physical, release or Plus acceptance.
